faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar MTS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) position at IIT Ropar is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) position is a 12th pass.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MTS position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) position is up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the MTS role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) role will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Ropar MTS recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending a detailed CV via registered post to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves CV screening followed by online and in-person interaction.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.

faq.question: Q10. What details should be included in the application?
faq.answer: The application should include a detailed CV and self-attested copies of required documents. The subject line of the postal mail should clearly state "Application for the position of Multi Tasking Staff".
